meta.name: gpt-image-2-style-library
meta.description: Choose GPT-Image2 / gpt-image-2 visual styles and industrial prompt templates from the awesome-gpt-image-2 style library. Use when an agent needs to create, rewrite, classify, or improve image-generation prompts with repository-backed templates, categories, style tags, scene tags, pitfalls, and example cases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 套用风格模板，产出专业图像提示
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正为AI绘画工具的提示词表达发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Use style templates to craft polished image-generation prompts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to phrase and style prompts for AI image tools.

howto.what: 把用户的图像生成想法转成可直接使用的 GPT-Image2 提示词：从内置风格库匹配模板和风格，按固定结构生成包含主体、构图、视觉风格、文字、比例、避坑细节的完整提示，并先给出可复制版本。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、重写或改进图像生成提示等任务时触发，也可直接点名该技能。

say.text: 用 gpt-image-2-style-library 生成一张城市生命系统图谱

say.text: 把这段产品海报想法改写成 GPT-Image2 提示词

howto.what_en: Converts a user's image-generation request into a ready-to-use GPT-Image2 prompt: matches templates and styles from the built-in library, builds a structured prompt with subject, composition, visual style, text, aspect ratio and constraints, and provides a copyable version first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, rewrite or improve image-generation prompts, or explicitly invokes the gpt-image-2-style-library skill.

say_en.text: Use gpt-image-2-style-library to generate a city life system map
say_en.note: Matches a library template and outputs a prompt

say_en.text: Rewrite this product poster idea into a GPT-Image2 prompt
Pick a template for a Japanese-style character from the style library and write a prompt
say_en.note: Generates a full prompt from the selected template
